propositions: The inbound link differ is ADD-only by construction and never removes links deleted on the peer side, while the outbound direction has a removal path, creating asymmetry and silent information loss.

A link deleted in Jira stays on the local rebar ticket forever because _diff_links_inbound iterates only the current issuelinks and emits adds for unseen links, with no walk of local deps for missing ones.
The apply layer silently discards removal records due to an `action != 'add'` filter in _inbound_update_apply_links, so even a correct differ cannot effect removals without fixing the action branch.

The ecosystem research shows that peer-side deletion mirroring is not commonly implemented by mature tools (Aha!, Asana, Workfront, Exalate) and carries data-loss risk, informing a deferral of removal-mirroring implementation.

The correct arbitration between inbound and outbound differs requires a per-binding history of what the peer previously held, which is already available via the baseline mechanism established in change 1296 for parents.
